name: Meleeniacs ALPHA
desc:
DOUBLE SPOOLS EVERY WEEKEND!

Meleeniacs is an action packed melee fighting game with dozens of wacky weapons, maps and characters!
Game is currently in Alpha, and things are expected to change!

🎮 New updates every Month!

⚔️ Each weapon has a unique ability, be it passive or something you can activate!

👽 Follow for updates and leave a thumbs up to help support the development of the game for free!

🐸 Join the group for updates!
